limitations: One head, single module/thread and contiguous Q/K/V arrays; no real model DPI, scheduling, GQA or cache-footprint equivalence.
Q1 is a standalone query, not deployed paired-head scalar decode.
Each sample starts a new process and performs one warm evaluation; only repeated clock eval calls are timed.
Fixed deterministic normal-magnitude fixture; no whole-model performance or quality claim.
Four configurations share an iteration count per shape, calibrated to at least100ms for the fastest configuration when feasible. Calibration is recorded separately and is not a result.
Original and paired binaries have separate baseline code layouts; report each baseline and do not attribute all change solely to online recurrence.
